title: Stock Log Collection
description: Append-only log of all stock movements — inbound deliveries, outbound sales, and manual adjustments. Collection: stock_log. Document ID: Firestore auto-generated.

type.description: Stock movement type: in=received from vendor, out=sold, adjustment=manual correction, wastage=spoiled/discarded, carry_over=opening stock from previous day

movement_type.description: Deprecated alias for type — use type field

quantity.description: Quantity moved. Always positive — movement_type conveys direction.

log_date.description: Date of the movement in YYYY-MM-DD format

reference_id.description: Document ID of the source — vendor_orders/{id} or sales/{id}

stock_before.description: Stock quantity before this movement (optional — for auditing)

stock_after.description: Stock quantity after this movement (optional — for auditing)

notes.description: Free-text reason (required for adjustment and wastage types)

created_by.description: UID or name of the staff who recorded this movement

created_at.description: Firestore Timestamp — exact time of log entry
